scope: Domestic formation research, partial official-source verification only

llc.filing: Online or paper mailed to Division of Corporations
llc.annual_report: Due January 1–May 1, beginning calendar year after formation/effective date; regular fee $138.75; late filing $538.75

llc.publication: Two designated newspapers, six consecutive weeks; Certificate of Publication filed within 120 days, $50 government filing fee, newspaper charges separate; exceptions apply

llc.annual_report_due: First day of anniversary month; administrative dissolution exposure if still unpaid after 60 days
llc.paper_processing: Up to 15 business days following receipt; no expedited processing

llc.registered_agent: Registered agent required; in-state business location may permit self-agent, subject to statutory qualifications

DE.filing_caution: Document upload is submission, not direct electronic formation or instant acceptance. State filing fees not independently confirmed.

limitations: Only explicitly cited field claims were researched
Corporation requirements missing in several states
Tax, agent, filing class and special-case verification incomplete
Do not use this file to imply 8 completed, reviewed guides
